title: Group the People Given the Group Size They Belong To
description:
There are n people labeled from 0 to n - 1.

You are given an array groupSizes, where:

groupSizes[i] = size of the group that person i must belong to
Task

Form groups such that:

Each person i is placed in a group of size groupSizes[i]
Every person appears in exactly one group
All groups satisfy the required sizes

Return a list of groups (each group is a list of person IDs).

If multiple valid answers exist, return any one of them
It is guaranteed that at least one valid solution exists
Examples

Example 1
Input: groupSizes = [3,3,3,3,3,1,3]
Output: [[5],[0,1,2],[3,4,6]]

Explanation:

Person 5 forms a group of size 1
Persons [0,1,2] form a group of size 3
Persons [3,4,6] form another group of size 3

Other valid outputs are also possible.

Example 2
Input: groupSizes = [2,1,3,3,3,2]
Output: [[1],[0,5],[2,3,4]]

Constraints
1 ≤ n = groupSizes.length ≤ 500
1 ≤ groupSizes[i] ≤ n
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n representing the number of people.
The second line contains n space-separated integers representing the group sizes for each person.
output_format: Print each group on a new line. For each group, print the space-separated identifiers of the people belonging to that group.
